title: Workflows
group.userEmpty: No workflow of your own yet — duplicate a built-in to start
typeHint.design: Write a doc: a session writes a doc, the user approves it.
typeHint.build: Build with lanes: split the doc into items, hand them to lanes, done when none is left.
typeHint.general: General work: the project session, takes work outside any doc.
typeHint.lane: Lane: each lane does one item through its phases.
typeHint.locked: Connected — remove its edges to change the type.
edge.laneBuild: Lanes do the Build step's items
edge.dropHere: Drop to insert a step here
palette.title: Add a step — drag
palette.dropHint: drop on an edge to insert
why.onlyOne: A workflow has exactly one General step and one Lane step
why.oneBuild: A workflow has at most one Build step
why.onEdge: Drop on an edge to insert the step
why.pickEdge: Pick an edge first (Tab to its label, Enter), then Enter on this block to insert the step there
why.buildEnd: Build only connects to Done — nothing comes after Build
why.buildLast: Build only goes right before Done
why.outside: General and Lane stay outside the chain
why.loop: This makes a loop — the chain goes one way
why.oneIn: A step has one way in — drag a block to insert one
why.afterBuild: No doc step comes after Build
bar.brokenDisk: Fix the file on disk — the app reads it again by itself
impact.used: Save → {n} {n:project|projects} on this workflow run the new rev
impact.docs: {n} open {n:doc keeps|docs keep} the old rev
menu.deleteUsed: used by {names} — switch those projects first
broken.title: The hand-edited file has an error — projects still run the valid rev of {at}
broken.none: The hand-edited file has an error — no valid rev yet
offline: Disconnected — reconnecting · unsaved changes stay on the page; Save comes back once connected.
check.title: Pack check
check.locked: Save is locked until no error is left
check.V1: The file is broken and cannot be read — fix it in the file
check.V2: The pack is missing its main workflow file
check.V3: Invalid step name — use lowercase letters, digits and -
check.V4: The step has no valid type (Write a doc, Build with lanes, General work or Lane)
check.V5: The pack needs exactly one {type} step ({n} now)
check.V5any: The pack needs exactly one General work step and one Lane step
check.V6: This step connects to a step that does not exist
check.V7: The chain is not right: each step leads to one next step, no branches, no loops
check.V8: This way of starting the next step does not apply to this edge
check.V9: The Lane phase list is not right: no duplicates, at most 8 phases, done last
check.V10: The doc name is needed when the pack has a Write a doc step, and empty when it has none
check.V11: The pack folder holds a stray or too large file
check.V12: A setting in the file has the wrong type or is missing
check.V13: The file has a setting the app does not know
check.V14: The instructions have an unknown or repeated slot
check.V15: The doc folder must be inside the project
legend.hardText: the engine blocks it, the model cannot get around it
legend.softText: goes into the system prompt, the model usually follows it but is not forced
panel.settingsSub: click the canvas background to open
panel.readOnlyNote: Built-ins cannot be edited. A copy can be edited fully.
panel.brokenNote: The file is broken, so it cannot be edited here — fix it in the file, the app reads it again by itself.
f.name: Name
f.bodyPlaceholder: No instruction yet. Write how this step should work…
f.docsHint: This step's docs live in this folder.
f.labelWaiting: Group while waiting for the next
f.rulesBase: Always on: commits name their item, no dependency loop, … (base rules)
rule.priority_first.hint: Priority items go to a free lane first.
rule.one_item_per_lane.hint: A lane holds at most one open item.
rule.outside_item_new_lane: Outside work gets its own lane
rule.outside_item_new_lane.hint: An item outside any doc goes only to a new lane of its own.
rule.no_recreate_cancelled.hint: No new item named like a cancelled one.
rule.max.hint: Write-a-doc + Build sessions per project (1–6); at the limit the open-step buttons dim.
slot.drain: Safe stop when work runs out
slot.rule_outside_item_new_lane: Rule: Outside work gets its own lane
edgeP.title: Edge {from} → {to}
edgeP.approveHint: Fixed by the step types: after a doc step, the next opens only once the doc is approved.
edgeP.drainHint: Fixed by the step types: Build is done when no item is left.
edgeP.buttonHint: The doc goes to "{waiting}" with a "{start}" button.
edgeP.autoHint: The engine opens the {step} session as soon as the doc is approved.
clone.title: New workflow name
clone.hint: Copies the whole pack ({n} files) into the library. Enter to create · Esc to cancel.
create.title: New workflow
create.name: Name
create.blankSub: Only General and Lane, no instructions
conflict.title: The workflow file changed outside the app
conflict.text: "{name}" was edited outside the app after it was opened on the canvas. The canvas has unsaved changes.
conflict.how: Reload — drop the canvas changes and read the file on disk. Overwrite — replace the file on disk with the canvas (the hand edit is lost).
leave.title: Discard unsaved changes?
leave.text: "{name}" has unsaved changes. Leaving now loses them.
delete.title: Delete workflow "{name}"?
delete.text: The folder goes to the Trash.
imp.title: Import workflow "{name}"
imp.renamed: "{name}" exists — it will be added as "{as}"
imp.errors: {n} {n:error|errors} — fix the folder and import again
imp.viewerNote: This text goes into the system prompt of every {step} session on this pack. Read only — add it, then edit it in the library.
author.editDirty: Save or discard your changes first
author.limit: 3 drafts open — save or drop one
author.describeHint: Like the PO workflow but with a Plan step before Build, and no gate phase for lanes
author.createNote: Claude writes a draft on the canvas; nothing is saved until you click Save. Runs on {account} and spends real quota.
author.createNoteAuto: Claude writes a draft on the canvas; nothing is saved until you click Save. Runs on the orchestrator account and spends real quota.
author.pendingSub: Claude edits a draft; the pack changes only when you click Save
author.fixStopped: Tried to fix it {n} times, {e} {e:error|errors} left — keep talking or edit by hand
author.saved: Saved "{name}" · {projects} {projects:project|projects} using this pack will run the new version · {docs} {docs:doc|docs} in progress keep the old one
author.savedShort: Saved "{name}" · not applied to any project yet — apply it from the Workflow chip in the Tasks tab
author.saveErrors: Not saved: the pack still has {n} {n:error|errors}
author.conflict: Not saved: the workflow files changed outside the app — drop the draft and edit the version on disk
author.undone: Undone — the draft is open again
author.quota: Account {from} is out of quota — switch to {to} ({left} % left) and continue?
author.quotaNone: Account {from} is out of quota — no account has room
author.later: Turn stopped — save what is done or send a message to go on
author.noAccount: No account has room to run the authoring session
author.startFailed: Could not open the authoring session — send again to retry
author.resumeFailed: The old authoring session could not be reopened — the draft is kept; your next message opens a new session
author.placeRun: Next message — sends when this turn ends
author.placeSaved: Session closed — Undo to reopen the draft
author.discardText: Every change made in this authoring session will be lost.
